dish: butadon (high-heat grilled marbled pork loin, 1934 house sauce)
n: Obihiro Hageten Honten (帯広はげ天 本店)
w: Tempura and local-food house founded 1934, whose first chef Yano Shōroku helped devise the butadon sauce — marbled loin seared fast at high heat, a restrained sweet glaze.

n: Rokkatei Obihiro Main Store (六花亭 帯広本店)
w: The 1933 Tokachi confectioner's home store — the Marusei Butter Sandwich, crisp pies and assortments, with a second-floor kissa café.

dish: Muroran curry ramen (thick curry broth, house curly noodles)
n: Aji no Daiō Muroran Honten (味の大王 室蘭本店)
w: Serving its thick, rich curry ramen since opening in Muroran in 1971 — the bowl that made curry ramen the city's new local dish; house-made medium-thick curly noodles.
